description: GB300 GPU coverage, thermal envelope, power and clocks from in-band DCGM and node-exporter telemetry. Every aggregate has an exactly-matching detail table beneath it. ECC, remapped rows, limit violations and XID live on the GPU Error Surface board.

options.content:
GPU Health — coverage, thermal, power and clocks
GB300 NVL72 estate. Live tray and GPU counts are the tiles below, not a fixed figure. Sourced only from in-band tray telemetry (DCGM exporter, node exporter) pushed straight to VictoriaMetrics. Every aggregate on this board has an exactly-matching detail table beneath it.
GPU area › Area home  ·  Coverage · thermal · power · clocks  ·  Error surface — ECC · XID · violations  ·  NVLink & bandwidth  ·  Readiness checks

panels.title: Fleet telemetry coverage, thermal envelope and power

panels.description: Decomposed per rack below — the Trays column sums to this number.

targets.expr: count(count by(node) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}))

panels.title: Trays reporting DCGM

panels.description: Scrape targets returning up=0. Every one of them is named in the worklist directly below; the row count equals this number.

targets.expr: count(up{job=~"dcgm|dcgm-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: DCGM exporters not responding

panels.description: Decomposed per rack below — the Rack GPU power column sums to this number.

targets.expr: sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Fleet GPU power draw

panels.description: Highest core temperature in scope. The Max core temp column of the per-rack table peaks at this value; the hottest-GPU table names the GPU.

targets.expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Hottest GPU core

panels.description: Highest HBM temperature in scope. The Max HBM temp column of the per-rack table peaks at this value.

targets.expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Hottest HBM stack

panels.description: Worklist for the stat above, built from the identical selector and filter. One row per non-responding DCGM exporter.

defaults.noValue: All DCGM exporters in scope are responding.

targets.expr: up{job=~"dcgm|dcgm-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 0

panels.title: DCGM exporters not responding — the exact trays

panels.description: Decomposition of the tiles above, same selector and same variables. Trays sums to "Trays reporting DCGM", Rack GPU power sums to "Fleet GPU power draw", and the two temperature columns peak at the two "hottest" tiles. The fleet GPU count is owned by the CVT inventory board, so it is shown here per rack only.

targets.expr: count by(rack, su) (count by(node, rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}))
count by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
sum by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
avg by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Coverage, thermal and power by rack — the exact racks in scope

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Trays reporting DCGM': row count equals count(count by(node)(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP)) under the same $cluster/$datahall/$su/$rack/$node/$gpu variables. The footer also verifies two other tiles on this page: the 'GPUs reporting' total is every GPU series DCGM is exposing, and the 'Tray GPU power' total equals the 'Fleet GPU power draw' tile. Per-GPU maxima live in the 'Hottest GPUs in scope' table below.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

sum by(node)(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

avg by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: GPU power draw by SU

panels.description: Names the individual GPUs behind the "Hottest GPU core" stat: the top row equals it exactly. The row set is a value cut (core temp >= fleet max - 2 °C) rather than a top-N rank, so all five columns select the identical GPUs and no cell is blank. Sorted hottest first.

targets.expr: max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

panels.description: Names the individual GPUs behind the "Hottest HBM stack" stat: the top row equals it exactly. Same value-cut construction as the core-temperature table to its left, anchored on HBM temperature instead, so all five columns select the identical GPUs. Sorted hottest first.

targets.expr: max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) >= scalar(max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})) - 2)

targets.expr: avg by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: GPU utilisation by SU

panels.description: Average and peak SM clock per SU. The exact racks behind these lines are in "Clocks by rack" immediately below; the fleet peak equals the maximum of that table's "Max SM clock" column.

targets.expr: avg by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: SM clock by SU (MHz)

panels.description: Fleet minimum, mean and maximum memory clock across every GPU in scope. The exact racks are named in "Clocks by rack" immediately below: the min plotted here is the minimum of its "Min mem clock" column and the max is the maximum of its "Max mem clock" column. On a healthy GB300 estate all three lines sit on top of each other because HBM runs at a fixed clock — a line separating is the signal.

targets.expr: min(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: Memory clock — fleet min / mean / max (MHz)

panels.description: Backing detail for "SM clock by SU" and "Memory clock — fleet min / mean / max". Same selector, same variables, same instant. The fleet maximum SM clock plotted above is the maximum of the "Max SM clock" column; the fleet minimum and maximum memory clock are the minimum of "Min mem clock" and the maximum of "Max mem clock". Every GPU in scope is counted in the GPUs column. An idle GB300 GPU parks its SM clock near 120 MHz, so a low value here is normal on an idle estate; the column is deliberately uncoloured.

targets.expr: min by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
min by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
count by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})
